description: This Java source file defines the class `GenericDAO`, which provides data access methods for entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functionality for inserting, updating, selecting, and deleting entities, as well as handling complex queries involving views, conditions, and relations. The class serves as a generic Data Access Object to interact with various entity models, encapsulating SQL generation and execution.

classes.name: GenericDAO
classes.description: Provides methods for CRUD operations and complex queries on entities, including handling view entities and relations, within the Apache OFBiz framework.
